text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A Hokkaido fair... The venue is— 
Oh, it's at the local department store.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! And there's an eat-in booth, 
a diner from Hidaka...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the shopkeepers themselves 
came out. 
Since it's right there, maybe I can go 
eat—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The final day is today... 
Even if I head out right now, I won't make 
it in time, will I?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only I'd noticed earlier. 
What a shame...

title: By the Time I Noticed, It Was Too Late
